description:

Skills Requirements:

• 5-8+ years of experience writing performant Python code following modern best practices

• Minimum 1 year of experience building and deploying products powered by large language models (LLMs) in fast-paced, professional environments

• Proven experience leading technical projects and driving them from concept through production deployment

• Experience making architectural decisions for AI/ML systems and evaluating technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability

• Hands-on experience with statistical machine learning techniques as well as hybrid approaches combining LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and embeddings-based models, including vector search

title: Lead, Business Development & Licensing - Sureel AI
description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group , Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

title: Ohio Remote Clinical Therapist
description:
About WellQor :

WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.
Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for ensuring each patient is achieving the best possible outcomes. We're not a directory service, we're a full service psychology practice. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team, and our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
The WellQor organization was founded to serve the needs of specialized populations. WellQor serves the needs of mature adults, and Wellfam serves the needs of teens and adolescents. Our providers understand the unique situational issues and clinical mental health challenges of each population.
Our practice is growing rapidly, and we owe our success to a family-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor .

Your Role as a Remote Clinical Therapist:
At WellQor , you’ll help your clients overcome anxiety, deal with grief, forge better relationships with their families, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference in the lives of others, and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.
And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback. Clinicians collaborate with our Clinical Directors to develop treatment plans and obtain valuable feedback to ensure the best possible patient outcomes.

You will define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.
Why WellQor ?

• You’ll develop long-term relationships with patients via teletherapy.

• Have access to the full support and camaraderie of a clinical team.

• Select how much and when you work.

• Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.

• Receive credentialing, billing, and administrative services so you can do what you do best, therapy!

Join the WellQor Family and let us build a caseload for you that fits your lifestyle.

Title: WellQor Telehealth Clinical Therapist

Reports to: Clinical Director / Lead Psychologist

Requirements:

• LPCC, LMFT, LMHC, LCSW, LICSW, PsyD or equivalent licensed to practice independently.

• Empanelment / Participation with commercial insurance plans helpful but not required

• Strong computer skills and comfort using mobile devices and electronic medical records systems for patient charting and communication

Responsibilities:

• Conduct regular teletherapy sessions with clients

• Typical issues that your patients may face include:

• Adjustment issues, anxiety, depression, personality disorders, grief, behavioral issues PTSD, substance abuse

• Enter and maintain appropriate documentation in WellQor 's, easy to use web based EHR system according to company guidelines.

• Utilize our unique WellQor Clinician Connect™ platform to share ideas with and obtain support from other WellQor clinicians and leadership nationwide.

Compensation:

WellQor Telehealth Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they're interested in carrying at any given time.

title: Quality Assurance Engineering Manager
description:
The Company
2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 Canada Recipient & Fast 500 North America Recipient 🏆

SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.
Utilities face urgent demand to replace inefficient legacy systems while managing increasing operational complexity, and evolving customer expectations. With more than a decade of experience, and a track record of successful implementations spanning water, electric, and gas utilities, SpryPoint has built a reputation as a trusted and mission-critical partner to utilities across North America.
We deliver comprehensive solutions including SpryCIS, SpryEngage, SpryMobile, and SpryWallet that modernize the entire meter-to-cash process. What sets us apart? Our "updates, not upgrades" approach, user-centric design, and unwavering focus on customer success.
Backed by strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners since 2023, and an exciting new investment partnership from Insight Partners announced in 2026, we're accelerating our growth while staying true to our core values: lead with kindness, vision with impact, radical honesty, bold disruption, keep it simple, and execute with excellence.
Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas.
We are standing up a dedicated QA automation function, and we're looking for a QA Engineering Manager to build and lead it from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to shape a quality practice from scratch: you'll choose the tooling, set the standards, hire the team, and define how AI fits into how we test.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading the team and doing the work yourself: setting direction, hiring, and coaching on one side, and writing automated tests, building framework components, and reviewing code on the other. You'll lead by example and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls and earn the trust of the engineers you lead.
In your first 90 days, you'll start with discovery: partnering with our Principal AI Engineer and AI team to understand existing AI tools and practices, and working with engineering teams to understand current QA practices and define how QA and engineering will collaborate going forward. In parallel, you'll confirm prerequisites (environments, CI/CD, critical user journeys), select your tooling and framework, and stand up a proof-of-concept suite on the highest-risk flows. By the end of year one, you'll have delivered a working, trusted automation suite on critical flows, a small high-performing team, a quality metrics dashboard in active use, and a clear plan for AI adoption.
What You Will Do

• Define and own the quality engineering strategy and roadmap across our products.

• Stay hands-on: personally write automated tests, build framework components, and review code alongside the team (roughly half your time).

• Select the test automation tooling and framework, and set the standards squads build on.

• Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines and partner with DevOps on stable, repeatable deployments.

• Define quality gates: what blocks a merge and what blocks a release, aligned with engineering leadership and risk.

• Drive a risk-based approach to testing so effort goes where it protects clients most.

• Push tests down the stack (API before UI), drive down the flaky-test rate, and enable squads so the practice doesn't depend on any one person.

• Hire, coach, and grow

to provide telehealth sessions.

About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

• FREE group and individual clinical supervision provided

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with employer matching

• Paid time off

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

• Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

• CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

• Student loan repayment assistance

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Shimmick , through our subsidiary, Axia Electric, is seeking a highly talented BIM Manager with data center experience to oversee digital modeling, coordination, and clash detection for complex, mission-critical construction projects.
This challenging position offers an excellent growth opportunity supporting the delivery of sophisticated data center projects. You will play a key role in project success by leading BIM coordination efforts, driving clash detection and resolution, and ensuring high-quality digital project delivery from design through construction.
At Axia, we are problem solvers. Creative thinkers. Innovators. We approach each project with fresh ideas and big thinking in pursuit of better answers, better outcomes, and better experiences for our clients. We are resourceful, nimble and resilient. We work hard together-and with our clients-to deliver high-quality projects that are on time, on budget and beyond expectations.
Axia Electric
Axia Electric headquartered in Riverside, California, is a leader in heavy civil and industrial electrical construction, serving public and private owners across water/wastewater, transportation, transit, renewable energy, and power generation markets. Over the past decade, Axia team has grown tremendously, securing major projects, including the $350 million North City Pure Water Facility in San Diego and the $235 million EVMWD Regional Water Reclamation Facility Expansion Project in Lake Elsinore, CA.
We specialize in complex, large-scale systems requiring deep expertise in power distribution, instrumentation & controls, and integrated commissioning. We are rapidly growing into the Mission Critical workspace and seeking to grow a team knowledgeable in Data Center construction.
Responsibilities
The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

• Team Leadership: Direct, mentor, and schedule daily tasks for a team of BIM coordinators and modelers.

• BIM Execution: Establish, implement, and enforce project-specific BIM Execution Plans (BxP) and modeling standards.

• Clash Resolution: Lead multi-discipline coordination meetings to identify and resolve spatial conflicts between structural and hyper-complex MEP systems.

• Mission-Critical Focus: Ensure precise modeling of data center infrastructure, including containment systems, high-density cable trays, cooling pathways, and backup generators.

• Model QA/QC: Audit models regularly to guarantee data integrity, proper naming conventions, and compliance with strict LOD (Level of Development) 350/400 requirements.

• Cross-Functional Liaison: Collaborate directly with project managers, field superintendents, design engineers, and client stakeholders to resolve technical challenges.

Qualifications
Minimum Requirements:

• BA/BS degree + 6 years of relevant BIM/VDC experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

• Strong understanding of heavy industrial MEP systems, including chilled water loops, medium-voltage distribution, and structural layouts.

• Ability and willingness to travel to project sites and client locations as required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience dedicated specifically to data centers or complex mission-critical facilities.

• Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Navisworks Manage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud (BIM 360).

• Exceptional communication and leadership skills required to run high-stakes coordination meetings and drive accountability.

Additional Information:

• This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization.

The salary range for this position is between $120,000 to $175,000 depending on experience and/or education.

title: Open Source Contributor (GitHub)
description:

We are looking for highly skilled Open-Source Software Engineers to contribute to an AI training project involving software development, repository exploration, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.
We are particularly interested in engineers who own or maintain open-source repositories or have made meaningful contributions to established projects. Contributions should demonstrate real engineering ability, not only documentation updates, dependency bumps, formatting changes, or minor typo corrections.
Candidates should be prepared to discuss specific repositories, pull requests, issues, and code they personally authored.

• Explore and understand unfamiliar software repositories.

• Implement, modify, and debug front-end and back-end components.

• Trace data and execution across interfaces, services, libraries, APIs, databases, and external dependencies.

• Reproduce software issues and identify their underlying causes.

• Implement solutions that fit an existing project’s architecture and contribution standards.

• Write unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests.

• Review AI-generated patches for correctness, completeness, security, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

• A public or otherwise verifiable GitHub profile .

• Meaningful ownership of or contributions to one or more open-source repositories.

• Strong software-engineering experience across front-end, back-end, full-stack, systems, developer tooling, infrastructure, or another substantial technical area.

• Experience with multiple programming languages.

• Ability to understand and modify unfamiliar codebases.

Relevant languages may include TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C++, C#, Ruby, PHP , or other languages used in substantial open-source projects.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.
Start Timeline & Availability
We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first tasks within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior IT Auditor to own IT General Controls (ITGC) and technology risk across our audit program. You'll assess risk across our core systems and vendors, design and execute testing where formal processes don't yet exist, and be a key point of coordination with external audit and our co-source partner on all IT-related matters.

This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone who wants real ownership over how technology risk is assessed and controlled as the company scales - and who's excited to apply AI and automation to make testing faster and more effective, not just more of the same

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You'll work closely with the CIO org, Engineering, Security, Finance, external audit, and our co-source partner to build a rigorous, efficient ITGC program from the ground up.

More than that, we believe you will thrive by taking ownership of:

- Contributing the IT risk assessment and translating it into a prioritized testing plan across access, change management, and operations

- Designing new ITGC testing processes, workpaper templates, and documentation frameworks from scratch

- Coordinating with external audit and the co-source partner on timelines, deliverables, and open items for IT controls

- Leading walkthroughs with system owners and IT stakeholders across key applications and infrastructure

- Testing access provisioning/deprovisioning, change management, and system operations controls across in-scope systems

- Assessing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports for key vendors and subservice organizations, and evaluating complementary user entity controls (CUECs)

- Assessing control deficiencies for severity and root cause, and driving remediation plans to completion with system and process owners

- Implementing AI-driven and automated solutions to reduce manual testing effort and improve testing coverage

WHAT YOU BRING

You're a controls-minded IT audit professional who pairs technical fluency with strong judgment. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, enjoy owning a program end-to-end, and know how to translate technology risk into a practical testing plan.

- 3+ years of experience in IT audit, ITGC testing, or a related IT risk/compliance function

- Big 4 or co-source firm experience in IT audit

- Demonstrated experience building or significantly enhancing an ITGC testing program or methodology from scratch

- Strong understanding of access management, change management, and system operations control concepts

- Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports and assessing vendor/subservice organization risk

- Strong track record managing external audit and/or co-source relationship

title: Principal Engineer - Game Innovation
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Backed by a brand known the world over for gaming, entertainment, and hospitality, we operate like a fast-moving startup with a passion for building products millions of people play.
Our Games Studio is building the next generation of in-house casino content, and we are changing how that content gets made. We are building an AI-assisted development pipeline to design, build, and ship real-money games faster, and using it to go after formats the floor is not saturated with: Crash, Plinko, Mines, arcade-style games, skill-adjacent experiences, and formats that have not been invented yet. Two things at once: a new method for making all our games, and new kinds of games to make with it.
What's the position?
We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Game Innovation to be the technical lead for this effort. You will design and stand up the AI-assisted game development pipeline, own the architecture that takes a game from concept to a certified title live on our RGS, and build games on it yourself. You will pair with the Senior Producer, Game Innovation, who owns the product and the roadmap, while you own the technology and the build.
This is a hands-on principal role, not a management track. You will write code, make the architectural calls, and set the engineering standard for how AI-built games get produced and shipped in a regulated environment. The first question, can AI build a game, is already answered by working prototypes. The harder question is whether we can build a real framework that produces games we would put in front of real players for real money. That is your problem to solve.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the pipeline. Design and build the AI-assisted game development pipeline: a shared project with version control and CI/CD, agents that produce math, art, sound, and animation from a structured brief, automated evaluation gates, and a playable build the team can open from a link. Make it repeatable, so the second game is faster than the first.

• Own the architecture, front end to back end. Set the architecture for the game client and the back-end game server, including the round lifecycle, bet validation, outcome mapping against a certified RNG, wallet operations, reconciliation, RTP reporting, and the audit trail. Keep the math and the money server side.

• Integrate with our RGS. Lead the integration to Fingenuity, our RGS and RNG, and own the path that turns a candidate build into a certifiable, shippable title across jurisdictions.

• Build games, not just infrastructure. Stay hands-on. Prototype mechanics, build game clients and servers, and prove the pipeline by shipping real titles through it.

• Set the AI engineering standard. Define how we use AI-assisted tools and agents in game development: the conventions, the guardrails, the human review gates, and the automated checks that verify AI output before it advances. Nothing AI-generated ships uninspected.

• Choose the stack. Make the build, buy, and partner calls on engine, tooling, and infrastructure, and standardize the studio on choices that are strong for AI-assisted development and support the client and server model.

• Partner across the business. Work with platform engineering, compliance, and our RGS and third-party partners. Bring the studio's math, art, and production talent along, and keep the bar high on quality and speed.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers who join this effort, establish the code review culture, and document the patterns so the pipeline outlives any one person.

Requirements
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a builder at principal level who wants to invent the way games get made, not maintain someone else's system. Someone who has shipped real-money games, understands what certification actually demands, and is genuinely excited about what AI does to the economics

Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Team Lead, Legal Response
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Lead a team of Legal Response agents day-to-day: assign and triage incoming law enforcement requests, monitor SLA and quality performance, and step in on complex or time-sensitive cases.

•
Coach and develop team members, conduct regular 1:1s, and flag performance or capacity issues to your Manager.

•
Act as first-line escalation point for law enforcement requests and internal stakeholder queries (Legal, Compliance, Risk, Customer Service ), resolving what you can and escalating what you can't with clear context.

•
Maintain and enforce SOPs for handling law enforcement and regulatory requests; surface process gaps or inefficiencies to your Manager with a recommended fix.

•
Own team-level metrics and reporting: SLA adherence, backlog aging, error rate, and volume trends - using the team's data and reporting tools directly.

•
Serve as subject matter expert on law enforcement request handling for your team and adjacent functions.

•
Maintain working knowledge of company products sufficient to communicate credibly with external stakeholders (law enforcement, legal representatives).

•
Support your Manager on process improvements, projects, and cross-team initiatives as needed.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

•
Ensuring daily operations run smoothly; escalate incidents to your Manager and relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.

•
Monitor SLA, backlog, and error-rate KPIs; identify trends and quality issues before they become escalations.

•
Conduct weekly/monthly performance reviews with team members, distinct from informal 1:1s.

•
Coordinate with L&D on training and re-training needs identified through performance monitoring.

•
Lead or contribute to process improvement projects and workshops.

•
Plan team shift schedules to maintain 24x7 coverage, and manage shrinkage against plan.

•
Participate in recruitment activities ( screening , interviewing) for the team.  

What We Look For In You

•
A degree in law, compliance, or a related field, or equivalent experience demonstrating critical thinking.

•
Prior experience leading or supervising a team, comfortable holding others accountable.

•
Comfortable working with data: reading SLA/volume/error dashboards and using them to make day-to-day team decisions, not just reporting numbers upward.

•
Strong written and verbal communication; detail-oriented, especially under time pressure.

•
Able to work independently and as part of a team.

•
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.

•
Strong people skills: Ability to navigate difficult situations and stay calm under pressure.

•
Solutions mindset: passionate to find the right solution and resolve the issue.

•
Excellent time management: ability to multi-task to solve issues while managing time.

•
Quick learner: ability to ramp up quickly and act on feedback constructively.

•
Willing to work on a rotational shift to support 24x7 operations.

•
Willing to work in Tun Razak Exchange (walking distance from MRT TRX).

Perks & Benefits

•
Competitive total compensation package

•
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•
Various team building programs and company events

•
Wellness and meal allowances&nbsp
